name: Puiggròs (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, the green charged with a white six-petalled flower and the yellow with three light blue six-pointed stars.
history: The official flag of Puiggròs is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, a horizontal bicolour of green and yellow, with the white sextifoil of the arms of diameter 1/4 of the length of the cloth centred in the upper half, and three light blue six-pointed stars; approved on 2 April 1998 and published in the DOGC.

features.role: three six-pointed stars in a row
